description: Get catch records by date or freshness tier. Returns the catch date, the region (district name), the blog post URL when published and, for records registered on the Midnight blockchain, a verify link per batch. Exact GPS coordinates are never returned: on v3 records the exact position is not on the chain (only a commitment to it); the record carries a zero-knowledge proof that the position lies within a range, and the district name is a label set by GYOTAK that is not part of that proof. In-stock products reference these records by date. To check a record on-chain without trusting GYOTAK, open its verify link, or call verify_catch with network "mainnet", the v3 contract address given in the response and the batch ID.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD format. Returns records for that specific date.

tier.description: Freshness tier: fresh=last 30 days, tier1=31-60 days, tier2=61-90 days

name: get_catch_reports
